title: The Limiting Cases of Affine Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev Inequalities
content: In this paper, we studied the limiting cases of $\alpha \to n^-$ and $\alpha \to 0^+$ in the affine Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev (HLS) inequalities proved in [25]. To be specific, we established affine logarithmic HLS inequalities and affine Beckner-type logarithmic Sobolev inequalities with respect to two different functions.
